name: ZipCheckup U.S. Water Quality Dataset
description: Water quality violations, lead/copper levels, radon zones, and Home Safety Scores for U.S. ZIP codes. Based on EPA SDWIS data.
source: U.S. EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS)

fields.lead_level_mg_l: 90th percentile lead level (mg/L), null if no data
fields.copper_level_mg_l: 90th percentile copper level (mg/L), null if no data
fields.radon_zone: EPA radon zone (1=highest, 3=lowest), null if no data
fields.home_safety_score: Composite score 0-100, null if insufficient data
fields.health_contaminant_names: Semicolon-separated list of health-based contaminant names
fields.ccr_contaminant_count: Number of contaminants reported in Consumer Confidence Report (CCR), null if no CCR data
fields.ccr_violation_count: Number of violations reported in CCR, null if no CCR data
fields.enforcement_action_count: Total EPA/state enforcement actions against the water system. null = enforcement data not available for this ZIP (NOT measured-zero).
fields.enforcement_health_violations: Number of health-based violations from enforcement records. null = enforcement data not available for this ZIP (NOT measured-zero).
fields.has_active_issues: Whether the system has currently active enforcement or violation issues (true/false). null = enforcement data not available for this ZIP (NOT measured-false).
fields.boil_water_advisories: Number of boil water advisories issued. null = enforcement data not available for this ZIP (NOT measured-zero).

null_semantics: A null / empty value means the underlying source did not have a record for that ZIP code (data not available / not yet matched), NOT a measured value of zero or false. This applies to all nullable fields above (lead_level_mg_l, copper_level_mg_l, radon_zone, home_safety_score, ccr_* , enforcement_action_count, enforcement_health_violations, has_active_issues, boil_water_advisories). Do not impute 0/false for absent records.

erratum.issue: Earlier dataset versions emitted enforcement_action_count=0, enforcement_health_violations=0, has_active_issues=false, and boil_water_advisories=0 for ZIP codes that had no enforcement record in the source (7579 ZIPs in this export). This conflated "data not available" with "measured zero / no active issues".
erratum.correction: From this version, those four fields are emitted as null (empty in CSV) when the ZIP is absent from the enforcement source. A 0/false now appears only when it is an actual measured value for a ZIP present in the source.
